pages.text: $(#ff9f43)【Amplify】$()$(br2)Lends every other affixed monster within 16 blocks one random extra affix, lost 10 s after leaving its range. Lent affixes drop no materials.$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Resonant Silver Charm, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)Once struck it keeps ringing, and sets the crystals around it ringing too.$()
